description:
Admissible proposal evidence: reconciliation meta_reported shows Meta dataset event totals beside gateway_verified events Plainrouter sent and Meta accepted. The separate purchases block shows Meta-reported Purchase counts under the account attribution setting beside Plainrouter accepted server-side Purchase counts, with its completed account-local window start and end dates and no purchase gap or status. purchases.plainrouter_accepted_purchases is null when it was not measured: the account timezone is missing or invalid, the account has no eligible destination, no account-local day of the purchase window is retained, or part of the window is older than retained delivery records; null means unavailable, while 0 is a measured zero. Includes stored daily Meta spend and delivery metrics. platform_claimed_clicks means Meta outbound clicks. Days before 2026-06-29, or not re-read by the daily sync since 2026-09-27, may still hold Meta link clicks or all clicks.
purchases.basis_note explains how the two counts differ.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID. Signals reads use the workspace Meta destination when omitted; other tools may require an ID when multiple accounts are active.

days.description: Number of reporting days to compare, from 1 to 90.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_performance

plainrouter_accepted_purchases.description: Count of Purchases Plainrouter sent and Meta accepted; null means unavailable because it was not measured: the account timezone is missing or invalid, there is no eligible destination for the account, no account-local day of the purchase window is retained, or part of the window is older than retained delivery records. A measured zero remains 0.
